name: B10-0176/2024 (Verts/ALE) – Recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on the Commission's plan to update EU guidance on smoke- and aerosol-free environments. It asks Member States to ban smoking and vaping in more outdoor places, including restaurant terraces, parks, beaches, playgrounds and transport stops, and in private cars when children are present. It also wants nicotine pouches banned in schools. The text is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks Member States to widen smoking and vaping bans and protect children.
- **Who it affects:** Smokers, vapers, businesses with outdoor seating, schools, and children.
- **What happens next:** Member States decide whether to follow the guidance; the Commission reports back in four years.
